deadline.value: The faculty page gives no closing date for admission. Applications are made through Promovendus and on paper at the Doctoral Office.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: A university lecturer or TUD Young Investigator from the faculty must agree to supervise you, with at least one more supervisor in a team.
supervisor.quote: you must find a university lecturer from the Faculty or a TUD Young Investigator from the Faculty

funding.value: The pages checked do not state how many doctoral candidates are funded.

entry_route.value: A good university degree is generally needed, typically a Diplom or Master's with a research thesis.
entry_route.quote: typically a Diplom or Master’s program with a research thesis

notes: The Department of Geosciences has its own doctoral coordinator on this page, so the record lists earth as also_fields. The faculty regulations are dated 2 February 2026. The page says applications to open proceedings under the 2014 regulations are accepted until 21 December 2026.
